rows.en: ...Forty years. It took forty years to make that a reality.
rows.notes: Bahbem to Watari: forty-year realization remains intentionally unidentified.

rows.en: Will we be ready in time?
rows.notes: Watari asks whether their preparations will meet the deadline.

rows.en: There is no need to worry. We should be able to prepare the planned number.
rows.notes: Bahbem reassures Watari about the planned production quantity; noun remains unspecified.

rows.en: Though some of them use material repurposed from the Fossil Beasts we acquired.
rows.notes: Production materials include recovered Fossil Beast material; some, not all.

rows.en: Fossil Beasts, you say...
rows.notes: Watari echoes the material source with a deliberately trailing reaction.

rows.en: They are fine dolls in their own right. Pitiful beings that can never become gods, though.
rows.notes: Fossil Beasts are the dolls; dismissive divinity contrast preserved.
Intentional silence; also used after the battle in i026a:6.

rows.en: Besides, there is also a unit equipped with super robots and those artificial humans, is there not?
rows.notes: Bahbem refers to the Nahel Argama force, its super robots and artificial humans.

rows.en: They are ideal for buying time... No, as decoys to draw our gaze and the enemy to them.
rows.notes: Both our gaze and the enemy are drawn by the force; self-correction preserved.

rows.en: Yes, I believe that is what NERV truly intends.
rows.notes: Watari confirms NERV intention as his inference.

rows.en: Why not entrust the RahXephon to that unit as well?
rows.notes: Bahbem proposes transferring RahXephon to that same force.

rows.en: They may be able to operate it more effectively than you at TERRA.
rows.notes: They is the Nahel Argama force; you at TERRA addresses Watari's organization.

rows.en: Furthermore... if Mu targets them, we can buy ourselves time as well.
rows.notes: Mu targeting the force buys Bahbem and Watari time.

rows.en: You mean to use the Nahel Argama as a cradle?
rows.notes: Watari preserves Bahbem's cradle metaphor for the Nahel Argama.

rows.en: Precisely. They succeeded in wiping out the Dotems on their own, did they not?
rows.notes: Dotem is the D2 class, distinct from Dolem; success was unaided.

rows.en: ...Yes.
rows.notes: Brief affirmative answer to row14, with initial hesitation.

rows.en: Then they are more than qualified to be the Pied Piper of Hamelin.
rows.notes: They is the force; Pied Piper metaphor preserves Hamelin reference.

rows.en: But assigning the RahXephon to that unit risks leaking information to NERV... No, to SEELE.
rows.notes: Watari fears information reaching NERV, then corrects this to SEELE.

rows.en: Oh, that is no concern. We already know most of each other's cards. ...Thanks to that document.
rows.notes: We and each other are Bahbem's side and SEELE; document is deliberately unnamed.

rows.en: Besides, they could never understand the RahXephon System...
rows.notes: They is SEELE; trailing connective thought retained.

rows.en: Unless both Instrumentalists awaken, it is impossible for anyone to master it.
rows.notes: Both Instrumentalists must awaken before mastery; subject restored impersonally.

rows.en: What if NERV schemes to physically destroy the RahXephon?
rows.notes: Watari asks a conditional question about physical destruction, not information theft.

rows.en: That man, Gendo Ikari, would do no such thing.
rows.notes: Gendo Ikari is explicitly named; male pronoun supported by glossary.

rows.en: He would instead try to use the RahXephon to deceive SEELE.
rows.notes: He is Gendo; SEELE is the object of deception.

rows.en: ...I have already given him some information to steer his thinking in that direction.
rows.notes: Bahbem supplied some information to manipulate Gendo's thinking.

rows.en: Then... may I take it that the matter of the RahXephon is settled?
rows.notes: Watari requests confirmation of the RahXephon deployment decision.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Bahbem affirms the deployment decision.

rows.en: Commander Kunugi, I have brought Ayato Kamina.
rows.notes: New briefing scene: Haruka reports bringing Ayato to Kunugi.
Silence retained.
Repeated silence is reused across several original scene positions.

rows.en: They are both giving each other the silent treatment. This is just like a quarrel between children.
rows.notes: Isshiki thinks about Kunugi and Ayato's mutual silence; thought kind retained.

rows.en: ...Your last examination confirmed that there is nothing wrong with your body.
rows.notes: Kunugi to Ayato: results of last examination, physical condition.

rows.en: Ah... S-see, he means it is a good thing you were not hurt.
rows.notes: Haruka tries to soften Kunugi's blunt announcement; stutter preserved.

rows.en: How can you say that after keeping me locked up in a place like that for so long?
rows.notes: Ayato rebukes his interrogators for confinement; me restored.

rows.en: And you made me undergo tests over and over again...
rows.notes: Ayato continues his complaint about repeated forced tests; deliberate trailing sentence.

rows.en: Are you saying people who come out of Tokyo are not human?
rows.notes: Ayato challenges treatment of people emerging from Tokyo.
Intentional silence; also Isshiki's reaction to Itsuki at s0260:331.

rows.en: Do you think my blood will turn blue, too?
rows.notes: Ayato fears his own blood turning blue as well.

rows.en: That is...
rows.notes: Haruka begins a reply but trails off; fragment retained.

rows.en: ...For now, we have decided where you will be living here in Nirai Kanai.
rows.notes: Kunugi changes the subject to Ayato's arranged lodging in Nirai Kanai.

rows.en: Captain Shitow, please show him the way.
rows.notes: Kunugi orders Haruka Shitow to guide Ayato; rank and surname retained.

rows.en: Yes, sir. ...Come on, Ayato. Let's go.
rows.notes: Haruka acknowledges Kunugi and invites Ayato to leave.

rows.en: ...Don't touch me.
rows.notes: Ayato rejects Haruka's touch; contraction restores his curt spoken register.
Haruka reacts in shocked silence; punctuation-only source preserved.

rows.en: ...In that case, I will take him there.
rows.notes: Itsuki volunteers to escort Ayato after rejection of Haruka.

rows.en: Who are you...?
rows.notes: Identity question fits both Itsuki introduction at i026b:47 and Rikudo at i026b:89.

rows.en: Me? I am Itsuki Kisaragi, from the Science Research Department.
rows.notes: Itsuki introduces himself with full name and department.

rows.en: Would you mind if I took him there?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks Haruka permission to escort Ayato; direction is explicitly asking.
Haruka's silence in reply retained; no invented acceptance.

rows.en: It seems that settles it. Shall we go, Ayato?
rows.notes: Itsuki takes Haruka's silence as settling the escort question; invites Ayato.

rows.en: ...Yes.
rows.notes: Ayato agrees to leave with Itsuki.

rows.en: Itsuki!
rows.notes: Sayoko calls to Itsuki; sensei honorific dropped per established convention, without adding an unsupported rank.

rows.en: Ah, Nanamori.
rows.notes: Itsuki greets Sayoko by surname, Nanamori.

rows.en: Here, this is a disc recording of the D1 Aria. I have somewhere to go, so could you take it for me?
rows.notes: Itsuki hands Sayoko a recording and asks her to carry it because he has elsewhere to go.

rows.en: It is a new song, right? Understood.
rows.notes: Sayoko confirms this is a new song and accepts the errand.

rows.en: What is the D1 Aria?
rows.notes: Ayato asks what D1 Aria means; D1 source label retained.

rows.en: It is the song the Mu's Dolems sing. Nanamori and I study it here.
rows.notes: Itsuki explains Dolem song and his joint research with Nanamori.

rows.en: The Dolems'... song...
rows.notes: Ayato's thought echoes the Dolem song in a deliberate fragment.

rows.en: You are Ayato Kamina, right? What do you think of Nirai Kanai?
rows.notes: Sayoko confirms Ayato identity and asks about his impression of Nirai Kanai.

rows.en: Kanai City, an experimental city at sea, was built by adding artificial structures to Nirai Island to investigate the ruins...
rows.notes: Itsuki explains island/city construction for ruins research; explanation trails into next row. Coordinator terminology provenance recorded in campaign_terms.json; wording unchanged.
uncertain: Natural Nirai Island versus artificial Kanai City corroborated; independently licensed English wording remains unestablished.

rows.en: Hence Nirai Kanai. Rather a clever play on words, wouldn't you say?
rows.notes: Itsuki supplies combined Nirai Kanai wordplay and asks Ayato appreciation.

rows.en: Uh-huh... So, what are those ruins...?
rows.notes: Ayato's hesitant response then asks about the ruins; trailing question retained.

rows.en: Ah, they are the Neriya Temple right there in front of us.
rows.notes: Itsuki identifies the ruins as the temple directly ahead. Coordinator terminology provenance recorded in campaign_terms.json; wording unchanged.
uncertain: Existing Neriya Temple literal retained; independently canonical English wording remains unestablished.

rows.en: And your RahXephon is being kept inside it.
rows.notes: Itsuki explains RahXephon is housed inside that temple.

rows.en: ...Ra-ra?
rows.notes: Quon addresses Ayato with her characteristic Ra-ra; preserve questioning fragment.

rows.en: Oh, you're...!
rows.notes: Ayato recognizes Quon; preserve interrupted recognition.

rows.en: Hi, Quon. How did things go today?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks Quon about today's medical visit; next answer settles context.

rows.en: The doctors here are idiots... If I really felt fine, I wouldn't have to get a checkup every day...
rows.notes: Quon complains about daily examinations; restore first-person subject, preserve trailing endings.

rows.en: You're right about that.
rows.notes: Itsuki agrees wryly with Quon's complaint.

rows.en: Um... who is she?
rows.notes: Ayato asks Itsuki about Quon; referent and gender settled by source introduction.

rows.en: She's Quon Kisaragi. My younger sister.
rows.notes: Itsuki introduces Quon; possessive ties sister to speaker. Appositional second sentence.

rows.en: Your sister...
rows.notes: Ayato echoes the surprising relationship; deliberate echo fragment.

rows.en: And she's a collaborator with TERRA, you could say.
rows.notes: Itsuki adds Quon's loose TERRA affiliation, retaining hedged status.

rows.en: It's nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Quon greets Ayato; introductory yoroshiku, no reversed request.

rows.en: O-okay...
rows.notes: Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: Well, this is the house you'll be staying at.
rows.notes: Itsuki brings Ayato to Rikudo's home.

rows.en: I think you'll be heading somewhere else again soon... But while you're here in Nirai Kanai, this will be your home.
rows.notes: Itsuki promises Ayato a home here despite imminent onward travel; all three clauses retained.

rows.en: Somewhere else again...?
rows.notes: Ayato echoes vague onward destination; deliberate question fragment.

rows.en: Well, contact me once you've introduced yourself. I'll come pick you up.
rows.notes: Itsuki tells Ayato to contact him, then promises to collect him; direction restored.

rows.en: Y-you...! Wait, you're the one who's coming to stay here starting today!?
rows.notes: Megumi recognizes Ayato and discovers today's guest is him; stutter retained.

rows.en: Huh?
rows.notes: Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: ...It's quite different from the city and the house you lived in, isn't it?
rows.notes: Rikudo addresses Ayato about his new surroundings; preserve both city and house.

rows.en: I'm Shougo Rikudo, the owner of this house. ...Come on, Meg. Introduce yourself.
rows.notes: Rikudo introduces himself then prompts Megumi; source-short Meg preserved.

rows.en: ...I'm Megumi Shitow. Nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Megumi introduces herself to Ayato, reserved greeting.

rows.en: Shitow...? Could you be...?
rows.notes: Ayato recognizes Haruka's family name; deliberate unfinished inference.

rows.en: Yes, she's Haruka's younger sister.
rows.notes: Rikudo resolves Ayato's inference; sister is Megumi.

rows.en: Then does Haruka live here too?
rows.notes: Ayato asks Rikudo about Haruka's residence.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Rikudo affirms; ignore documented stray closing bracket and empty line.

rows.en: Well, it'll take you a while to get used to it... Just think of this as visiting relatives, and make yourself at home.
rows.notes: Rikudo reassures Ayato; preserve adjustment, relatives comparison, and invitation.

rows.en: ...I... don't really know what that's like. ...I've never gone to visit relatives.
rows.notes: Ayato cannot relate to visiting relatives; restore I, retain hesitant admission.
Rikudo's deliberate silence at Ayato's lack of family visits.

rows.en: Meg, you've still got time, right? Show Ayato around the neighborhood.
rows.notes: Rikudo directs Megumi to guide Ayato, not the reverse; nickname preserved.

rows.en: Whaaat!?
rows.notes: Megumi's drawn-out protest at being asked to guide him.

rows.en: What's the matter? What do I always tell you?
rows.notes: Rikudo invokes his usual advice, later explained at 113; replace self-reference uncle with I.

rows.en: Okaaay...
rows.notes: Megumi reluctantly agrees; drawn-out response and trailing ending.

rows.en: ...How did you know about me?
rows.notes: Ayato asks Megumi why she already recognized him.

rows.en: I work for TERRA, just like my big sister.
rows.notes: Megumi explains she and Haruka both work for TERRA.

rows.en: ...Then does your uncle work there too?
rows.notes: Ayato asks about Rikudo; restore work action from previous line.

rows.en: No. Apparently he used to be a famous archaeologist... but he's retired now.
rows.notes: Megumi explains Rikudo's civilian status and hearsay about past fame.

rows.en: Hey... what's Tokyo like?
rows.notes: Megumi asks Ayato about Tokyo.

rows.en: What's it like...? It's just a city.
rows.notes: Ayato echoes question, then replies plainly; city subject restored.

rows.en: Hmm... I thought there might be something there.
rows.notes: Megumi expected something special in Tokyo; no invented feature.

rows.en: Why?
rows.notes: Ayato's natural one-word question asks why Megumi expected that.

rows.en: TOKYO JUPITER appeared before I was born, you see.
rows.notes: Megumi explains her lack of first-hand knowledge; fixed protected TOKYO JUPITER casing. Ignore stray bracket.

rows.en: And... my big sister has always said she'd go back to Tokyo, no matter what...
rows.notes: Megumi recounts Haruka's longstanding determination; retain quoted resolve and trailing ending.

rows.en: Haruka said that?
rows.notes: Ayato asks about the identified sister; restore reporting action.

rows.en: Yeah. She was born in Tokyo.
rows.notes: Megumi confirms Haruka's birthplace.

rows.en: Huh? Is it that late already?
rows.notes: Megumi checks time; next original line asks what is wrong.

rows.en: What's wrong?
rows.notes: Adjacent dialogue settles speaker/listener and referent; English retains complete subject/action.

rows.en: I have to go to TERRA headquarters. You know the way home, right?
rows.notes: Megumi leaves Ayato to return home alone; request direction correct.

rows.en: Well, see you later!
rows.notes: Megumi departs; natural farewell fragment retained.

rows.en: Oh, you're back already?
rows.notes: Rikudo greets Ayato's early return.

rows.en: She said she had something to do...
rows.notes: Ayato explains Megumi left; source trailing explanation retained.

rows.en: I see. Then I guess I'll have to make dinner myself.
rows.notes: Rikudo realizes Megumi cannot prepare dinner and takes the job himself.

rows.en: Um... Rikudo.
rows.notes: Ayato tentatively addresses Rikudo; vocative fragment deliberate. Fixed glossary spelling reconciled after meaning review; initial draft retained.

rows.en: Just call me Uncle.
rows.notes: Rikudo explicitly offers familiar Uncle address; retain source kinship address here.

rows.en: Okay. Um... Uncle, what is it you always tell Megumi?
rows.notes: Ayato returns to Rikudo's advice at 89, using newly offered address.

rows.en: Oh... it's nothing much.
rows.notes: Rikudo modestly introduces his advice.

rows.en: I tell her not to look away from things she doesn't like, but to face everything head-on.
rows.notes: Rikudo explains advice to Megumi: face unwelcome things directly; retain reporting I.

rows.en: Well, I'm sure you've got plenty going on yourself... but you're still young.
rows.notes: Rikudo gently extends reassurance to Ayato; source loose but completed clause ending retained.

rows.en: Welcome back, Director.
rows.notes: Soichi greets Watari at a scene transition; director from sourced position.

rows.en: I'm sorry I've left everything to the people on the ground.
rows.notes: Watari apologizes to Soichi for leaving on-site work to staff; subject/action restored.

rows.en: Here, these are souvenirs from the mainland... Photon Power rice crackers, a Shizuoka specialty.
rows.notes: Watari gives Soichi local souvenir; rice crackers literal senbei. Term awaiting central sourcing. Coordinator terminology provenance recorded in campaign_terms.json; wording unchanged.
uncertain: Photon Power rice crackers is source-literal souvenir wording; independently canonical English product label remains unestablished.

rows.en: Thank you. They're the ones that break with a crisp snap... right?
rows.notes: Soichi asks about the crackers' quoted snapping gag; crisp sound retained.

rows.en: Yes. Professor Yumi gave a wry smile when I met him a while back.
rows.notes: Watari recalls Professor Yumi's wry smile; topic suggested by cracker discussion but not added explicitly. Professor gender sourced.

rows.en: Did you stop by the Photon Power Laboratory too, Director?
rows.notes: Soichi asks Watari if he visited the lab, not whether he works there.

rows.en: No, that wasn't the case. More importantly, would you call Kunugi for me?
rows.notes: Watari denies visiting the lab and asks Soichi to summon Kunugi; request direction correct.

rows.en: Yes, sir.
...They've officially decided how to handle Ayato and the RahXephon...
rows.notes: Soichi privately infers official decision concerning both Ayato and machine; thought wrapper preserved by kind.

rows.en: You're telling me to fight the Mu!?
rows.notes: Scene switches to Kunugi's briefing: Ayato protests the order to fight Mu.

rows.en: That's right.
rows.notes: Kunugi confirms his order; adjacent original Ayato protest and Kunugi pilot rationale read.

rows.en: This is too one-sided! Why do I have to do it!?
rows.notes: Ayato rejects Kunugi ordering him to fight; explicit personal obligation restored.

rows.en: ...Ayato...
rows.notes: Deliberate worried thought/name fragment; honorific dropped.

rows.en: ...Because you can pilot the RahXephon.
rows.notes: Kunugi answers why Ayato must pilot.

rows.en: But...! Over here, you've got those robots called mobile suits, and...
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished list continued in row129.

rows.en: You've even got super robots bigger than those, don't you!?
rows.notes: Completes row128 list; larger super robots contrasted with mobile suits.

rows.en: Then why do I have to fight in the RahXephon!?
rows.notes: Ayato questions his own combat obligation.
Deliberate silence in both i026b:149 and s0260:295; latter follows Ayato choosing to act because he can pilot.

rows.en: As you've been told since coming here... our world, unlike Tokyo, has seen large-scale wars break out again and again.
rows.notes: Kunugi contrasts the outside world with Tokyo; repeated large-scale wars retained.

rows.en: And the embers of those wars have yet to die out... Humanity also faces threats other than the Mu.
rows.notes: Embers refer to those wars; additional non-Mu threats preserved.

rows.en: ...I know. Aliens, like the ones in movies and novels... That's what you mean, right?
rows.notes: Ayato identifies aliens using fiction as his frame of reference.

rows.en: For us, they are real.
rows.notes: They refers to aliens/threats in row134; subject and verb restored.

rows.en: But that doesn't mean...!
rows.notes: Deliberate unfinished objection retained.

rows.en: Hmph... He's just a child, after all.
rows.notes: Contemptuous thought about Ayato; male identity sourced from glossary.

rows.en: Well, considering he's being treated like a guinea pig, you can hardly blame him.
rows.notes: Itsuki privately excuses Ayato because of guinea-pig treatment.

rows.en: ...A dream arisen from the depths... blue eyes that illuminate the boy's face... that timbre...
rows.notes: Cryptic prophetic images and trailing timbre fragment retained; no invented explanation.
uncertain: Blue eyes and timbre remain poetic referents; context does not justify naming their owner.

rows.en: It's them...!
rows.notes: Kunugi recognizes the attackers; they remains unresolved until report in row141.

rows.en: U08 patrol reports! Contact Red! Targets confirmed as a D2 group! They are closing fast on Nirai Kanai!
rows.notes: Operator report preserves U08, Contact Red, D2 and high-speed approach to Nirai Kanai. Measured overflow compression: incoming transmission from U08 on patrol -> U08 patrol reports; approaching at high speed -> closing fast; target confirmation retained.
uncertain: U08/Contact Red/D2 are source labels with no separate canonical glossary entry.

rows.en: Put the entire island on emergency alert. DEFCON 3.
rows.notes: Commander orders island-wide emergency alert and DEFCON 3.

rows.en: Roger! DEFCON 3 declared across the entire island!
rows.notes: Megumi acknowledges and broadcasts the island-wide alert.

rows.en: Which Earth Federation Army units are nearby?
rows.notes: Restored question verb; military branch follows glossary.

rows.en: The Nahel Argama team is patrolling near Point 01998.
rows.notes: Point 01998 digits and team affiliation retained.

rows.en: There are too many D2s... Request support from them.
rows.notes: Kunugi orders Kim to request the patrolling team's support because of D2 numbers.

rows.en: Roger.
rows.notes: Military acknowledgment.

rows.en: What are D2s...!?
rows.notes: Restored definition-question verb.

rows.en: Dolems... As I explained before, they're Mu weapons that destroyed several cities in the great war fifteen years ago.
rows.notes: Haruka refers to her earlier explanation; several destroyed cities and fifteen years retained.

rows.en: Are you planning to send me out to intercept those things!?
rows.notes: Ayato asks whether they mean to send him to intercept Dolems.

rows.en: Of course. Why do you think we carried out Operation Overlord and...
rows.notes: Question deliberately cut at and, continuing row152.

rows.en: went to all the trouble of bringing a child like you here to Nirai Kanai?
rows.notes: Continues row151 question; deliberate cross-row syntax retained.

rows.en: You've got to be kidding! Nobody asked you to do that!
rows.notes: Nobody requested Operation Overlord/bringing him here; direction preserved.

rows.en: Stop complaining and hurry up and get into the RahXephon.
rows.notes: Kim orders Ayato into the RahXephon with impatient tone.

rows.en: I told you, I don't want to fight! I didn't get in because I wanted to!
rows.notes: Ayato rejects combat and says piloting was not voluntary.

rows.en: But you're the only one who can pilot it, aren't you?
rows.notes: Kim stresses his unique ability to pilot.

rows.en: That's your problem! It's got nothing to do with me!
rows.notes: Ayato says this is their concern, not his.

rows.en: What!? Are you planning to eat here for free!?
rows.notes: Free food accusation retained.

rows.en: I just have to get a job, right!?
rows.notes: Ayato offers work as alternative to piloting.

rows.en: Do you think a pampered kid like you can get by doing that!?
rows.notes: Pampered kid carries Kim's insult and sheltered-upbringing implication.
Context settled from the original neighboring dialogue; complete spoken subject/action retained.

rows.en: Stop it, Kim!
rows.notes: Megumi asks Kim to stop.

rows.en: Is there anything you can do besides pilot the RahXephon!?
rows.notes: Kim challenges Ayato's abilities beyond piloting.

rows.en: Yes, there is!
rows.notes: Explicit existential reply to row162; no grammatical omission retained.

rows.en: No, there isn't!
rows.notes: Explicit existential denial answering row163.

rows.en: You don't even know me...!
rows.notes: Ayato objects that Kim does not know him.

rows.en: I know more about the world than you do! Why... Why does someone like you get to be the RahXephon's pilot!?
rows.notes: Kim claims greater worldly knowledge and resents Ayato being the pilot.

rows.en: Hey, you two!
rows.notes: Haruka intervenes; deliberate call-out fragment.

rows.en: All right, that's enough. Both of you, go stand out in the hall.
rows.notes: Itsuki adopts teacher-like discipline toward both quarrellers.

rows.en: ...That's what I'd like to say, but this is hardly the time.
rows.notes: Itsuki qualifies the hall-punishment joke because the emergency prevents it. Meaning correction: source gives a complete qualification, so removed invented unfinished ending and made the emergency-context reason a complete clause.

rows.en: Ayato, we won't force you to fight... Could you at least stand by? In the RahXephon.
rows.notes: Itsuki asks Ayato to stand by in RahXephon while promising no forced combat.

rows.en: Itsuki, what gives you the authority to...!
rows.notes: Haruka challenges Itsuki's authority; deliberately unfinished sentence.

rows.en: The RahXephon can remain on standby. And request support from the Nahel Argama team.
rows.notes: Kunugi approves standby and orders support request.

rows.en: Y-yes, sir!
rows.notes: Stammered acknowledgment retained.

rows.en: Are you sure about this, Commander!?
rows.notes: Haruka checks commander's approval.

rows.en: Yes.
rows.notes: Kunugi affirms approval.

rows.en: You say that... but you're planning to make me fight in the end, aren't you!?
rows.notes: Ayato suspects standby promise conceals forced combat.

rows.en: You still don't get it!?
rows.notes: Kim rebukes Ayato.

rows.en: If you two don't cut it out, I really will make you stand in the hall, you know?
rows.notes: Hall location restored from row168; conditional threat directed to both.

rows.en: ...With buckets.
rows.notes: Deliberate add-on fragment; bucket punishment joke, no invented contents.

rows.en: Grr...!
rows.notes: Frustrated interjection.

rows.en: ...I'm just getting in, right?
rows.notes: Ayato confirms getting aboard only, without commitment to fight.

rows.en: Of course. You can trust me.
rows.notes: Itsuki reassures Ayato and requests trust; correct request direction.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Any allied unit is shot down.
rows.notes: Listener: player. Loss condition, plain text; preserves one line and the any-one-allied-unit trigger.

rows.en: The D2 group will enter Area 88 any moment!
rows.notes: Battle-map event4 operator report; D2 group imminent entry into Area 88.

rows.en: Activate the second interception system. Level 4!
rows.notes: Activate second interception system at Level 4; order syntax retained.
uncertain: Second interception system is a literal system description; canonical English label unconfirmed.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Military acknowledgment.

rows.en: How long until the Nahel Argama team arrives?
rows.notes: Kunugi requests Nahel Argama team arrival time; answer at s0260:212 is about three minutes.

rows.en: In about three minutes!
rows.notes: Kim answers Kunugi's ETA question about the Nahel Argama team's arrival.

rows.en: What's wrong, Ayato? Are you worried about what's happening outside?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks the silent Ayato about the fighting outside.

rows.en: ...No. Are you sure it's all right for me to stay like this?
rows.notes: Ayato asks whether staying out of combat for research really is acceptable; subject restored.

rows.en: Yes. RahXephon is an important research subject... And I'm a pacifist, after all.
rows.notes: Itsuki reassures Ayato with research and professed pacifism as reasons.

rows.en: ...He'll be angry if he finds out the truth.
rows.notes: Sayoko refers to Ayato, whose sourced gender is male.

rows.en: What would he find out?
rows.notes: Itsuki asks what truth Ayato would learn; full question restores the implied action.

rows.en: He doesn't know those are electrodes attached to a guinea pig, does he?
rows.notes: Sayoko calls Ayato the experimental guinea pig; those refers to the apparatus, not a literal animal.

rows.en: I haven't lied to him. He hasn't asked, so I just haven't told him.
rows.notes: Itsuki defends withholding the purpose of the electrodes; subjects restored.

rows.en: Then it's all right if I tell him?
rows.notes: Sayoko asks permission to tell Ayato the truth.

rows.en: You won't do it.
rows.notes: Itsuki predicts Sayoko's action, rather than forbidding it.

rows.en: Why wouldn't I?
rows.notes: Sayoko challenges Itsuki's prediction; restored implied action.

rows.en: Truth and happiness are surprisingly far apart. You're grown-up enough to understand that, aren't you?
rows.notes: Itsuki appeals to Sayoko's maturity while arguing against telling Ayato.

rows.en: Heh heh...
rows.notes: Sayoko laughs quietly at Itsuki's response.

rows.en: Alpha 1, you're clear to launch!
rows.notes: Kim authorizes Elvy's launch; operational label Alpha 1.

rows.en: I don't need a child's help against D2s. I'll avenge my comrades...!
rows.notes: Elvy dismisses needing Ayato and declares revenge for her comrades.

rows.en: I'm counting on you, Elvy...!
rows.notes: Haruka asks Elvy to handle the enemy; request direction preserved.

rows.en: That fighter... I'm sure I saw it in Tokyo...
rows.notes: Ayato recalls the fighter from Tokyo; thought and deliberate trailing recall preserved.

rows.en: ...Sorry, Ayato. I know we're on emergency alert, but can I talk to you?
rows.notes: Megumi asks to speak despite the alert, leading into Kim's backstory.

rows.en: W-what is it?
rows.notes: Ayato responds to Megumi, with stutter.

rows.en: It's about Kim... Her parents were killed.
rows.notes: Megumi explains Kim's anger; passive killing is explicit.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Ayato's surprise serves both Kim's bereavement and Reika's summons at use280.

rows.en: They were traveling in Australia when it happened... The Dolems killed her parents. That's why she's so...
rows.notes: Megumi explains Dolems caused Kim's bereavement; deliberate trailing explanation retained.
uncertain: Travelers interpreted as Kim and her parents from the bereavement account; Japanese omits the traveling subject.

rows.en: Then... Kim wants revenge on the Dolems...?
rows.notes: Ayato's thought draws the revenge inference; predicate restored, tentative ellipsis retained.

rows.en: D2s have entered the area!
rows.notes: Kim reports enemy entry.

rows.en: This is Bunga Mawar! I'm beginning my attack!
rows.notes: Elvy uses her sourced nickname as radio callsign.

rows.en: You damn clay dolls...! So you've come out of TOKYO JUPITER...!
rows.notes: Elvy insults the Dolems; clay-doll metaphor and source force retained.

rows.en: I'll avenge the comrades I lost in Operation Overlord!!
rows.notes: Elvy promises revenge for comrades lost in the named operation.

rows.en: Even D1s have come out! Damn Mu... Are they starting a full-scale invasion of our world...!?
rows.notes: Elvy reacts to D1 arrival; our world retains outside-Tokyo viewpoint.

rows.en: Can I really do this...? No, I have to...!
rows.notes: Ayato questions and then affirms his duty.

rows.en: Because I decided to do this!!
rows.notes: Ayato gives his own decision as the reason he must act; causal ending restored.

rows.en: So this is D1... Mu's Dolem...! Did Raideen make me fade-in so I could fight it...!?
rows.notes: Akira wonders whether Raideen drew him inside specifically to fight D1; sourced technique fade-in.

rows.en: Or was it something else that awakened Raideen...
rows.notes: Akira offers an unfinished alternative to the D1 explanation; identity deliberately unresolved.

rows.en: This enemy... It came out of TOKYO JUPITER!
rows.notes: Duke identifies the enemy's origin.

rows.en: Maybe they could 15 years ago, but we're here now! We won't let Mu do whatever they please!!
rows.notes: Koji contrasts the earlier war with the current defenders.

rows.en: So this is D1, Mu's main weapon... Are Mu starting another war, just like 15 years ago...!?
rows.notes: Ryoma identifies Mu's main weapon and fears renewed war.

rows.en: You bastard... You look like more of a challenge than that last clay doll...!
rows.notes: Kaine sizes up D1 against the previous Dolem; insult retained.

rows.en: Watch out, Ginga! That's a Mu robot!
rows.notes: Hokuto warns Ginga about the enemy affiliation.

rows.en: Mu are the ones who started a war before we were born, right!?
rows.notes: Ginga recalls Mu's earlier war; confirmation question retained.

rows.en: Yes! They say the whole world was in a huge panic back then!
rows.notes: Hokuto confirms and emphasizes reports of worldwide panic; no unsupported earlier telling is added.

rows.en: Things are different now! We'll crush them!!
rows.notes: Ginga declares the current defenders will defeat Mu.
Preserve wordless shock, including its later repeated use at s0210:979.

rows.en: What's wrong, stupid Shinji!? Are you getting cold feet again!?
rows.notes: Asuka taunts Shinji after his alarm; insulting nickname retained.

rows.en: N-no, I'm not!
rows.notes: Shinji denies being frightened, with stutter.

rows.en: What is this thing...? It seems hostile toward the EVA, but...
rows.notes: Shinji senses hostility toward EVA; thought and trailing qualification retained.

rows.en: Tch... So this is Mu's main force...! It looks tougher than that last clay doll!
rows.notes: Male lead appraises D1; runtime speaker placeholder preserved.

rows.en: How can you sound so carefree!? These things reduced many cities to ashes 15 years ago!
rows.notes: Female lead scolds male lead; source says many cities, without claiming countless cities.

rows.en: We're fighting to keep that from happening again!
rows.notes: Male lead answers the criticism with the purpose of fighting.

rows.en: What? Some of them aren't moving...!? Are they waiting for RahXephon to come out!?
rows.notes: Elvy wonders about stationary enemies waiting for Ayato's machine.
Ayato's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: Those included in this classification itself, those that just broke a jar...
rows.notes: Quon's cryptic taxonomy/broken-jar fragment retained as a poetic list.
uncertain: Cryptic poetic image: literal wording retained; scene does not explain the classification/jar or the visual banquet image.

rows.en: ! Is it a D1!?
rows.notes: Kunugi interprets Quon's warning as D1; complete question restored.

rows.en: Contact Red! D1 and D2 units are closing in fast!!
rows.notes: Megumi reports hostile contact; operational label preserved.

rows.en: Dolems...!!
rows.notes: Kim's bitter exclamation names the enemy; deliberate name-only utterance.

rows.en: ...I can hear a song...
rows.notes: Itsuki hears Dolem song; first-person subject restored.

rows.en: It's D1's Aria!!
rows.notes: Elvy identifies the D1 song/attack; campaign_terms establishes Aria is not a separate Dolem identity.

rows.en: From far away, once more, a sound that looks like a banquet...
rows.notes: Quon's synesthetic poetic fragment deliberately preserves seen sound and repeated distant banquet image.
uncertain: Cryptic poetic image: literal wording retained; scene does not explain the classification/jar or the visual banquet image.

rows.en: ...No, she'll be shot down...!
rows.notes: Quon foresees Elvy's defeat; the immediately following hit and Haruka's cry settle the referent.
uncertain: Elvy is inferred as the threatened target from immediate Alpha 1 hit; Japanese itself omits the target.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Elvy reacts to Quon's warning.

rows.en: Ah! Alpha 1...!!
rows.notes: Kim reacts to Elvy's fighter being hit; source deliberately cuts after subject.

rows.en: Elvy!!
rows.notes: Haruka calls Elvy's name in alarm; deliberate vocative.

rows.en: Damn it! I've got to break away!!
rows.notes: Elvy attempts to disengage from the enemy; her own action restored.
Deduplicated silence appears at ten uses; remains neutral silence.

rows.en: Y-you're... Mishima... Reika? You're alive... You've been alive all this time...!?
rows.notes: Ayato recognizes Reika; surname then given-name hesitation preserves source reveal order.
Quon's startled silence is a deliberate nonverbal utterance.

rows.en: Why are you inside RahXephon...!?
rows.notes: Ayato asks Reika about appearing in his machine; subject and verb restored.

rows.en: Come now... Let's go, Ayato...
rows.notes: Reika guides Ayato inside RahXephon; invitation retains inclusive let's; actual thought kind.

rows.en: A quantum condensation reaction inside Neriya Temple's barrier!
rows.notes: Megumi reports to command; reaction detected within the temple barrier; source-literal term retained.
uncertain: Neriya Temple is the existing source-literal glossary form; independently canonical English spelling remains unestablished.

rows.en: What did you say!?
rows.notes: Haruka reacts to Megumi's report; incredulous question.

rows.en: Heh... At last, it makes its entrance.
rows.notes: Isshiki reacts to RahXephon emerging; it is the machine, not an unnamed person.

rows.en: RahXephon has emerged!
rows.notes: Megumi reports RahXephon exiting its enclosure.

rows.en: ...Now that's cool...
rows.notes: Watari admires the emerging machine; casual evaluative expression, ellipses retained.

rows.en: A-Ayato...!
rows.notes: Haruka recognizes Ayato; name stutter retained.
Kim reacts to Ayato choosing to deploy; short why-question deliberately left as source fragment.

rows.en: Heh heh...
rows.notes: Itsuki quietly chuckles; lexical laugh retained.

rows.en: Doctor, you knew this would happen from the start, didn't you?
rows.notes: Sayoko addresses Itsuki as doctor and challenges his foreknowledge.

rows.en: Who knows? At least I haven't forced him to fight.
rows.notes: Itsuki evades Sayoko's question; he means Ayato, sourced male; explicitly denies coercion.

rows.en: Why... Why did you decide to come out and fight...!?
rows.notes: Kim asks Ayato why he chose to deploy; fight restored from reply and deployment context.

rows.en: Because I... can pilot it.
rows.notes: Ayato answers Kim; because-fragment is a complete response, with pilot ability explicit.
Kim reacts silently; exact exclamation preserved, no invented speech.

rows.en: I can pilot RahXephon. So I thought I'd do what I can... That's what I decided...!
rows.notes: Ayato explains choosing to act because he can pilot RahXephon; decision ending and hesitation retained.

rows.en: Have RahXephon intercept D1 and D2.
rows.notes: Kunugi orders the operators to have RahXephon intercept D1/D2; order direction explicit.

rows.en: Roger! Ayato, we're counting on you!!
rows.notes: Megumi acknowledges Kunugi, then asks Ayato to act; we are counting on him, not offering help.

rows.en: Yeah, I'll give it my best shot!
rows.notes: Ayato accepts Megumi's request; attempt rather than guarantee of victory.

rows.en: ...An untainted mirror... A heretical poet who weaves spiraling time...
rows.notes: Quon speaks prophetic poetic imagery as Raideen approaches; source noun-phrase fragments retained. Meaning correction: time itself is spiral/spiraling; source does not say poet makes it become a spiral.
uncertain: Prophetic mirror/heretical-poet metaphor is intentionally not resolved beyond the source imagery.

rows.en: It seems the other mechanical god has arrived...
rows.notes: Itsuki recognizes another mechanical god arriving; subject restored, referent Raideen per next event. Meaning correction: retain literal machine-work god image rather than recasting it as a god located inside a machine.

rows.en: Nahel Argama is entering the airspace over Nirai Kanai!
rows.notes: Megumi reports allied ship entering Nirai Kanai airspace.

rows.en: All units, immediately...
rows.notes: Bright begins an immediate all-unit order, interrupted by Torres; no invented launch verb at cutoff.

rows.en: Wait, please! There's an abnormal energy reading in the hangar!!
rows.notes: Torres interrupts Bright with hangar energy report; existential verb restored.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Exclamation; deliberate interjection fragment.

rows.en: R-Raideen...! Raideen is launching on its own!
rows.notes: Torres reports Raideen deploying autonomously; initial name stutter and interrupted lead-in retained.

rows.en: What!? Where's Akira!?
rows.notes: Misato asks for Akira's whereabouts upon autonomous launch report; question verb restored.

rows.en: H-he's already boarded the machine!
rows.notes: Torres answers Misato that Akira has already boarded; sourced male pronoun and stutter.
Ayato reacts silently; double exclamation preserved.

rows.en: Raaaaideeeeen!!
rows.notes: Akira's extended Raideen shout; canon spelling recognizable within vocal elongation.

rows.en: Ra... ideen...!?
rows.notes: Ayato haltingly recognizes Raideen's name; deliberate name separation retained.

rows.en: It looks similar...!? To this one...!
rows.notes: Ayato compares Raideen with his own RahXephon; similarity sentence deliberately breaks before comparator. Meaning correction: similarity predicate explicit before the deliberately delayed comparator; no inference about origin or identity.
Akira reacts silently; exact exclamation preserved.

rows.en: Th-this is... Raideen's cockpit...! What happened to me...?
rows.notes: Akira regains awareness in Raideen's cockpit; restore is and happened, retain disoriented pauses.

rows.en: That robot... Is it looking this way...!?
rows.notes: Ayato sees Raideen looking toward RahXephon; explicit subject and question.

rows.en: A-a girl...!?
rows.notes: Akira spots a girl following repeated Reika silences at s0260:315/317; startled noun fragment retained.

rows.en: Who are you...? Why are you up there?
rows.notes: Akira addresses that girl; later i026a:39 identifies her as standing on RahXephon's shoulder, hence up there.

rows.en: Akira, what's wrong!? Akira!!
rows.notes: Mari calls to Akira over comms; worried repeated name.

rows.en: ! M-Mari...
rows.notes: Akira recognizes Mari's voice; stutter and nonverbal exclamation retained.

rows.en: What in the world happened!?
rows.notes: Misato questions Akira about the unexplained launch.

rows.en: ...Raideen called me... And when I came to, I'd already faded in...
rows.notes: Akira says Raideen summoned him and he realized he'd already undergone fade-in; trailing account retained.

rows.en: What? So it wasn't you, Akira... Are you saying Raideen launched of its own free will?
rows.notes: Misato checks that Raideen's own will, rather than Akira's decision, caused the launch; full contrast and ending.

rows.en: Then it's just like what happened the other day...
rows.notes: Mari compares this with earlier awakening; i026a:31-35 later relates prior reaction before joining team, around Overlord.

rows.en: ...What is RahXephon doing?
rows.notes: Kunugi asks operators about RahXephon's behavior.

rows.en: It seems to be causing some kind of resonance, but we don't know the details!
rows.notes: Kim reports an apparent resonance phenomenon without details; it denotes RahXephon, no invented mechanism.

rows.en: Resonance... With that Raideen, rather than D1's Aria...
rows.notes: Kunugi observes RahXephon resonating with Raideen instead of D1's Aria song; predicate fragment deliberately retained.

rows.en: Does that mean there's some connection between those two...?
rows.notes: Haruka asks whether Raideen and RahXephon are connected; two machines restored as those two.

rows.en: ...A divine bird crowned with ancient light, cleaving through the blue forest...
rows.notes: Quon continues prophetic imagery of Raideen; divine bird metaphor, ancient light and blue forest all retained.
uncertain: Blue forest and ancient-light imagery retained literally; symbolic referents remain deliberately unspecified.

rows.en: I see... It seems we should revise our understanding of things.
rows.notes: Itsuki concludes they should revise prior understanding; subject and should-revise action restored.

rows.en: Akira, are you really all right...?
rows.notes: Mari checks Akira's condition after launch and resonance.

rows.en: Y-yeah... I'm fine now.
rows.notes: Akira reassures Mari, retaining stutter; no symptoms now.

rows.en: All right, have the rest of the units launch too.
rows.notes: Bright orders remaining units to deploy after Akira's reassurance; too preserved.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: The D1 and D2 readings have disappeared.
rows.notes: Megumi's event37 postbattle report, after victory/defeat condition UI; signatures no longer detected.

rows.en: Then contact Captain Bright Noa aboard Nahel Argama and ask him to come here.
rows.notes: Kunugi asks Kim to contact Colonel Bright Noa and request his presence; caller/addressee direction explicit. Coordinator terminology correction: Akurasu Bright Noa profile explicitly maps his Char's Counterattack rank 大佐 to naval Captain. Earlier Colonel rendering was incorrect; full original draft retained.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Kim acknowledges Kunugi's instruction.

rows.en: It seems we managed to get through this without incident.
rows.notes: Postbattle i026a:0; Watari says crisis resolved without mishap; no claim that attack never happened.

rows.en: Yes. We owe that in part to the Nahel Argama team.
rows.notes: Kunugi credits Nahel Argama team in part; full credit clause restored from grammatical Japanese ellipsis. Meaning correction: restore subject and credit predicate; thanks in part was grammatical Japanese ellipsis, not a deliberate cutoff.

rows.en: I was watching. It's good to let the people on the scene make the decisions.
rows.notes: Watari praises decisions made by on-scene personnel, then contrasts fifteen years ago after Kunugi's silence.

rows.en: ...We didn't have that fifteen years ago.
rows.notes: Watari refers back to on-scene discretion; past absence restored with we subject rather than implying literal no judgment.

rows.en: That was long ago... A long time ago...
rows.notes: Kunugi dismisses painful past; repeated fading phrase preserved.

rows.en: Anyway, about the contact between RahXephon and Raideen...
rows.notes: Kunugi changes topic to contact between the two machines after Watari's silence; about-fragment retained.

rows.en: It was their first encounter, but we'd anticipated this to some extent. All we can do now is watch them for a while.
rows.notes: Watari says first encounter was partly anticipated and observation is their only present option; both clauses retained.

rows.en: Then...
rows.notes: Kunugi begins concluding the exchange; deliberate trailing fragment retained.

rows.en: Yes. I'm counting on you to handle the rest.
rows.notes: Watari entrusts subsequent matters to Kunugi; asking him to handle rest, not offering Watari's services.

rows.en: RahXephon...?
rows.notes: Bright asks Soichi about the newly mentioned machine; name-only question retained.

rows.en: That's the name of 5A, the real objective of Operation Overlord, isn't it?
rows.notes: Misato identifies RahXephon as the operation's true target; 5A preserved.

rows.en: That's right.
rows.notes: Soichi confirms Misato's identification.

rows.en: Just what I'd expect from someone at NERV. You know things we never told you.
rows.notes: Isshiki's barbed praise targets Misato's access to classified information.

rows.en: Yes, and the same goes for you.
rows.notes: Misato turns Isshiki's accusation back on him; reciprocal subject restored.

rows.en: So... what does this RahXephon have to do with us?
rows.notes: Bright asks why their unit is involved; complete English question restored.

rows.en: Well... Colonel, we'd like you to take in RahXephon and its pilot, Ayato Kamina.
rows.notes: Soichi asks Bright to host both machine and pilot; request direction explicit.
Bright's wordless surprise retained.

rows.en: RahXephon...!?
rows.notes: Misato echoes the surprising machine name; intentional fragment retained.

rows.en: But isn't it TERRA's most closely guarded secret?
rows.notes: Douglas addresses TERRA representatives; secrecy superlative retained.

rows.en: It is, but... Director Shirow Watari and Commander Jin Kunugi made this decision.
rows.notes: Soichi names both officials and their titles in full.

rows.en: Could you tell us why?
rows.notes: Misato requests the reason for the transfer.

rows.en: It's the same thing your boss, Commander Gendo Ikari, has in mind... drawing the enemy away.
rows.notes: Isshiki tells Misato the operation shares Gendo's diversion strategy.

rows.en: You and RahXephon will act as decoys... and fight the Dolems that Mu sends out from Tokyo.
rows.notes: Isshiki's you denotes Bright's unit; both decoy role and fighting action retained.

uncertain: Rendered the source's long silence as '...'.

rows.en: To think Raideen and RahXephon would react like that...
rows.notes: Ryoma reflects on the resonance in battle; source's trailing astonishment retained.

rows.en: Looks like there's more to them than just looking alike.
rows.notes: Light infers a deeper relationship than appearance.

rows.en: Akira, can't you tell us anything?
rows.notes: Koji asks Akira for insight; stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: ...Actually, something like this has happened before.
rows.notes: Akira explains the previous incident to the group.

rows.en: Before...? Have you seen RahXephon before?
rows.notes: Ryoma asks whether Akira previously encountered the machine.

rows.en: No, that's not what I mean.
rows.notes: Akira denies Ryoma's interpretation.

rows.en: About two weeks ago... before Mari and I joined this unit, Raideen inside Divine Face Rock reacted in a similar way...
rows.notes: Akira recounts earlier resonance, dating it and locating Raideen; source trails off.

rows.en: About two weeks ago...? Do you mean during Operation Overlord?
rows.notes: Kaine matches Akira's date to the operation.

rows.en: I'm sure that was it...
rows.notes: Mari confirms the timing; stray closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: Then how are those two connected?
rows.notes: Kaine asks about the two robots' relationship.

rows.en: They didn't seem to be enemies... but I wouldn't say they looked like friends, either.
rows.notes: Tapp contrasts enemies and friends; robots are plural they.

rows.en: I don't know either, but... there's one thing that's bothering me...
rows.notes: Akira admits ignorance and introduces the girl sighting. Final meaning/punctuation review: Preserved the source's trailing lead-in by retaining final ellipsis.

rows.en: What's that?
rows.notes: Tapp asks what is bothering Akira.

rows.en: There was a girl standing on that robot's shoulder. She was wearing yellow...
rows.notes: Akira describes RahXephon's shoulder and yellow clothing; trailing description retained.

rows.en: A girl?
rows.notes: Light's incredulous echo retained as deliberate fragment.

rows.en: Was there a girl like that there?
rows.notes: Kaine checks his memory of the battle.

rows.en: No, I didn't see anyone like that.
rows.notes: Koji says he has no knowledge of the described girl; subject and perception restored from context.

rows.en: Never mind that. Isn't it strange for a girl to be on a robot's shoulder... in the middle of a battle, no less?
rows.notes: Ryoma stresses the implausible setting and combat timing, beyond whether anyone saw her.

rows.en: Y-yeah, you're right. Calling that dangerous would be an understatement.
rows.notes: Koji agrees with Ryoma's objection; stutter and intensity retained.

rows.en: Maybe you were imagining it, Akira?
rows.notes: Kaine questions Akira's perception.

rows.en: Yeah, exactly. Besides, keep talking like that and Mari'll start sulking, you know?
rows.notes: Tapp jokes about Mari getting jealous; named subject retained.

rows.en: I-I'm not...!
rows.notes: Mari's embarrassed denial cuts off; deliberate fragment retained.

rows.en: ...Nobody else could see that girl...
rows.notes: Akira privately realizes his companions could not see her, rather than merely failing to notice.

rows.en: Why could only I see her...? And what exactly is the connection between RahXephon and Raideen...
rows.notes: Akira questions his unique perception and robot connection; final question deliberately trails off.

rows.en: I'm going to that battleship? Is that really true...!?
rows.notes: Ayato asks Haruka about his transfer.

rows.en: Yes... Director Watari and Commander Kunugi ordered it.
rows.notes: Haruka attributes the order to both officials.

rows.en: You, Megumi and I will be assigned to the Nahel Argama unit in three days.
rows.notes: Haruka specifies all three people, destination and three-day delay.

rows.en: ...And of course, RahXephon will be coming too.
rows.notes: Haruka adds the machine to the transfer; complete English predicate restored.

rows.en: Wouldn't that be a good idea? This could be a chance to broaden your horizons by seeing different parts of Japan.
rows.notes: Itsuki encourages Ayato to explore Japan and learn from the experience. Final meaning/punctuation review: Restored an explicit subject and verb in Itsuki's rhetorical proposal; no shortening.

rows.en: You might even learn something about what's happening inside Tokyo.
rows.notes: Itsuki adds a possible benefit concerning Tokyo's interior.

rows.en: Besides, I hear that unit has plenty of people around your age...
rows.notes: Itsuki addresses Ayato and notes likely peers; trailing lead-in retained.

rows.en: So I think you'll make lots of good friends. ...Including Raideen's pilot.
rows.notes: Itsuki links peers to friendship and deliberately singles out Akira.

rows.en: Itsuki... do you know anything about the connection between those two?
rows.notes: Haruka challenges Itsuki after his suggestive remark about Akira.

rows.en: Well... I haven't the slightest idea either. What about you, Ayato?
rows.notes: Itsuki deflects Haruka's question and asks Ayato.

rows.en: I don't... know anything about that either.
rows.notes: Ayato also denies knowing the machines' relationship.

rows.en: I thought as much.
rows.notes: Itsuki's private, knowing response to Ayato; actual thought kind preserved.

rows.en: ...Anyway, you won't be going to the Nahel Argama unit right away, so take some time to prepare yourself...
rows.notes: Haruka reassures Ayato about the delay and offers mental preparation; deliberate trailing advice retained.

rows.en: No, I'm all right.
rows.notes: Ayato interrupts the need for preparation with reassurance.

rows.en: Huh...?
I've already made up my mind. I'll do what I can right now... I'll pilot RahXephon.
rows.notes: Ayato restates the resolve established at original 419/421; both decision and action explicit.

rows.en: Ayato...
rows.notes: Haruka's emotional name-only response retained.

rows.en: ...I see. So those two have met.
rows.notes: Bahbem receives the news of the machines' encounter from Isshiki.

rows.en: About RahXephon's assignment... will there be any problems?
rows.notes: Isshiki asks Bahbem about transferring RahXephon to the unit.

rows.en: This is not a matter for you to interfere in.
rows.notes: Bahbem sharply rebukes Isshiki for interfering. Final meaning/punctuation review: Made Bahbem's rebuke natural English while preserving Isshiki as the person barred from interfering.

rows.en: ...I apologize.
rows.notes: Isshiki backs down before Bahbem.

rows.en: ...There's no need to worry. Its song will not reach RahXephon without the Star of Ra Mu.
rows.notes: Bahbem's its points to Raideen, following 366/371; song and absence condition retained.
uncertain: The source uses an unnamed that one; Raideen as the song source is inferred from original 527 and 532. English keeps its rather than inserting a proper name.

rows.en: Then... Raideen really is...?
rows.notes: Isshiki starts a conclusion but leaves the identity unspoken.

rows.en: That is still only speculation.
rows.notes: Bahbem warns the conclusion is unproven.

rows.en: You can get the truth directly from Princess Lemuria... no, she is Reiko Hibiki now.
rows.notes: Bahbem identifies the same woman by old and current names, correcting himself. Final meaning/punctuation review: Corrected request direction: Bahbem advises Isshiki to obtain the truth; the draft's we incorrectly included Bahbem.

rows.en: Though... I already have some idea of what she and the people of that ancient empire are thinking...
rows.notes: Bahbem claims insight into Reiko and the ancient empire's people; no unsupported empire name added.
